description: Search the authenticated company's device fleet. Devices are returned as "assets" - the business-level representation of an enrolled or tracked device, including its policy assignment, custom data, tags, hardware specifications and last known location. Results are paginated; use "page" and "size" to page through a large fleet. Optionally narrow the search by device status, assigned policy, "lastSyncBefore" (each device's "lastSync", the portal's "Last sync", before an instant: use it for devices not synced, not seen or offline since a date; "syncedAt" is only the last status report), "lastSeenBefore" (asset record updated before an instant; not proof of being offline) and/or "missing" (devices without an IMEI or a serial number; count_devices counts them). To find a device the user names, use "query" alone (name, serial number, IMEI, model or tag): it returns up to "size" best matches, each with its "pathName" and the field that matched, instead of a page of assets. When no managed device matches, the query also looks at devices removed from management, returned with status DELETED, as a wipe or removal leaves them. To list which devices match filters (for example every device not synced since a date), pass fields "names": a table of each device's name, pathName, policy and lastSync, up to 200 a page, with the exact total and the next page, instead of 25 full devices.

company.description: Optional: a `company` value from list_companies to run this in. Omit it for the connection's own company.

fields.description: "names" lists the matching devices as a table of name, pathName, policy and lastSync, up to 200 a page, with the exact total and nextPage. Use it to say which devices match filters (status, policy, lastSyncBefore, lastSeenBefore, missing). Not with query.

lastSeenBefore.description: Only include assets whose record was updated before this ISO-8601 instant (e.g. "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z"). Metadata changes can update the record; this does not prove the device is offline. Must not be in the future. Minute-granularity: a device updated up to 59 seconds after this instant may still be included.

lastSyncBefore.description: Only include devices whose last sync (the portal's "Last sync": their last contact with Nomid) is before this ISO-8601 instant (e.g. "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z"). Use it for devices not synced, not seen or offline since a date. A device that never synced, or an asset without MDM, has no last sync and is never included. Must not be in the future. Minute-granularity: a device that synced up to 59 seconds after this instant may still be included.

missing.description: Only devices that have none of these identifiers: "imei" (no IMEI: a Wi-Fi-only device, or one that never reported it) and/or "serialNumber" (no serial number). Use it for questions such as how many devices have no IMEI, or which ones.

policy.description: Filter by the policy's path name (its unique short identifier, as returned by list_policies as "pathName" - not its human-readable display name).

query.description: Free text to find a device by name, serial number, IMEI, model or tag. Use it alone, without status, policy, lastSyncBefore, lastSeenBefore, missing or page.

size.description: Number of devices per page. Defaults to 10, capped at 25; with fields "names" defaults to and is capped at 200.

status.description: Filter by device status. ACTIVE = enrolled and functioning normally; INACTIVE = enrolled but disabled; SYNCHRONIZING = enrollment in progress; DELETED = removed from the fleet; REPROVISIONED = wiped and re-enrolled; EXTERNAL = tracked as an asset without MDM enrollment.
